theater: 重慶合州釣魚城與嘉陵江岸

battle.name: 釣魚城之戰
battle.theater: 重慶合州釣魚城與嘉陵江岸
battle.brief: 元憲宗八年（一二五八年）秋，蒙哥汗親率大軍入川，十月進抵合州釣魚城，圍城至次年七月。宋安撫副使王堅據山城固守，護國門外一字槽為攻守關鍵，蒙古軍雲梯、撞車與火藥器械屢攻不克；希臘火一類秘密配方的燃燒武器，於此正對上蒙古油罐火藥與宋軍儲水反制。七月蒙哥汗死於軍中，大軍解圍北還。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是蒙古帝國與南宋四川防區。蒙古方面由大汗蒙哥坐鎮，1258年率主力自陝西鳳州、興元一線入蜀，兵分數路：蒙哥親領一軍趨重慶方向，宿將汪德臣、其弟汪良顯與紐璘等分道並進，或攻成都、或攻潼川、或沿嘉陵江東下；兵力以草原騎兵為骨幹，雜以漢地降軍、畏兀兒與回回等部眾，並攜大批回回工匠隨軍，攻城器械、砲手與投石手隨隊同行。蒙哥的中軍營設在江岸平地，用以控制嘉陵江航運並安置造攻城器械的工場；忽必烈則領東路軍攻鄂州，與蒙哥一西一東構成鉗形，但兩軍各自為戰，並不互相隸屬。南宋方面以四川制置使余玠所建的山城防禦體系為骨架，釣魚城屬合州，是重慶外圍的前哨堡壘，由知合州兼四川安撫副使王堅率守軍據守，副將張珏等分守城門與岩堡；州縣屯軍、鄉兵與城內丁壯分層編組，彈藥糧秣就地籌備，援軍則由利州路、潼川府路沿江北上。朝廷中樞此時由賈似道主持，樞密院與制置司之間調度互有牽制，荊襄方向的防線同時吃緊，釣魚城的守援因此始終有限。整場戰事是宋蒙在四川東部的第一次硬碰硬：蒙古要的是山城體系背後的江上糧道與通道，宋軍要的是把蒙哥的主力釘在合州城下。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Southern Song's Sichuan front. On the Mongol side the great khan Möngke took command in person. In 1258 he led the main body into Shu from the Fengzhou and Xingyuan frontage in Shaanxi and split his force into several columns: Möngke himself led one group toward Chongqing, while his veteran commander Wang Dechen, Wang Dechen's brother Wang Liangxian and the general Niulin advanced by separate roads toward Chengdu, Tongchuan and the Jialing River. Grassland cavalry formed the backbone, mixed with surrendered Han troops, Uyghur and Huihui contingents, and a large train of Huihui engineers, artillerymen and stone-throwers travelled with the army. Möngke's central camp was pitched on open ground by the river below the fortress, both to hold the Jialing navigation and to shelter the workshops in which siege engines were built. Kublai led the eastern army against Ezhou, so that the two hosts formed a pincer from west and east, though they operated independently and were not subordinate to one another. On the Song side the defence rested on the network of mountain fortresses built by the Sichuan commander Yu Jie. Diaoyu belonged to Hezhou and was the outermost redoubt of the Chongqing line, held by Wang Jian, the military commissioner of Hezhou, with the deputy Zhang Jue in charge of the gates and the rock forts. County garrison troops, militia and city households were organised in layers; ammunition and grain were prepared on the spot, while relief columns marched north along the river from Lizhou and Tongchuan. At court Jia Sidao presided over the central government, the secretariat and the provincial command headquarters pulled against each other in the dispatch of troops, and the Jingxiang line was already under heavy pressure, so relief for Diaoyu remained thin throughout. The whole war was the first direct collision between Song and Mongol troops in eastern Sichuan: the Mongols wanted the river road and the passes behind the mountain-fortress system, the Song wanted to pin Möngke's main army beneath Hezhou.
people: 蒙哥是整場戰役的樞紐。他是成吉思汗之孫、窩闊台之弟，1251年即位為大汗，1258年自中亞回師，經西夏、隴右入蜀，志在先取全蜀再順流東下；他在釣魚城下的屯營與攻城部署，決定了蒙古第三次西征的最後走向。蒙古方面的另一關鍵人物是汪德臣，這位出身汪古部的宿將是蒙哥最倚重的攻城統帥，與弟汪良顯同在城下，1259年正月病逝軍中，年五十二歲；他死後宋方依軍禮請求歸還遺骸，蒙哥准許，合州遂立忠武祠祀之。他的卒年與死因在《元史》與波斯史料《史集》之間互有出入，可以確定的只是，他是此役蒙古方面的主要統帥之一。汪良顯繼領前鋒，屢攻不下，士卒折損頗重。釣魚城另一端是宋方主帥王堅，他據城拒守，屢挫蒙軍，又在護國門外一字槽打擊蒙軍攻隊；傳說他曾射中蒙哥兩箭，但蒙古方面的記載多把蒙哥之死歸於病勢，兩說至今並存。王堅其後出守襄陽，兵敗之後病卒。宋方真正的戰略支柱是四川制置使余玠，他十年間在四川興築的山城體系，是釣魚城能夠孤城抗蒙的制度前提；副將張珏守護國門一線，後來獨守重慶至1276年城破被俘。東路帥忽必烈與留守和林的阿里不哥，則在蒙哥死後成為汗位爭奪的兩端。
peopleEn: Möngke was the pivot of the entire campaign. A grandson of Genghis Khan and brother of Ögedei, he became great khan in 1251 and in 1258 returned from Central Asia into Shu by way of the Western Xia and Longyou territories, with the intention of taking all of Sichuan first and then moving down the river. His camp and his siege deployments below Diaoyu decided the final shape of the Mongols' third western campaign. The other key Mongol figure was Wang Dechen, a native of the Wanggu tribe and the veteran siege commander in whom Möngke placed the greatest trust, who served before the fortress together with his brother Wang Liangxian and died of illness in camp in the first month of 1259, at the age of fifty-two. After his death the Song side asked, by the rites of war, for the return of his remains; Möngke allowed it, and Hezhou later raised the Zhongwu Shrine in his honour. His year and manner of death differ between the Yuan Shi and the Persian Jami al-Tawarikh, and the only certain statement is that he was one of the principal Mongol commanders in this campaign. Wang Liangxian took over the vanguard, failed repeatedly to take the city and lost a good many men. On the Song side the commander was Wang Jian, who held the fortress, checked Mongol attacks repeatedly, and struck at the attacking columns in the yizicao in front of the Huguo Gate. Tradition says that he shot Möngke twice with arrows, while the Mongol accounts generally attribute the khan's death to illness, and both readings survive to this day. Wang Jian later went to command Xiangyang and died of illness after defeat. The real strategic pillar on the Song side was Yu Jie, the Sichuan commander who raised the mountain-fortress system over ten years; without that structure Diaoyu could never have held out alone. His deputy Zhang Jue held the Huguo Gate line and later defended Chongqing alone until the city fell in 1276. On the eastern front Kublai and the Mongol prince Ariq Böke, who stayed behind at Qaraqorum, became the two poles of the struggle over the khanship once Möngke was dead.
kits: 這張卡面的兵器是希臘火：拜占庭帝國自七世紀起秘藏的液態燃燒劑，裝在銅管或銅瓶之中，靠人力推送噴出並點燃，用來燒毀敵船與攻城器械，配方是帝國最高機密，據說隨一艘沉船而失傳，因此它在兵器譜系上代表的是秘密配方加銅製容器加覆蓋式燃燒這一條技術路線。釣魚城戰場上沒有拜占庭的銅管，這一點必須說清：蒙古軍實際攜帶的燃燒類器材是火藥炸藥與土製火砲，攻城所用的油罐與火藥炸藥亦見於當時蒙古軍的攻城記載；宋軍這邊的應對是城上諸樓櫓悉儲水以御敵火，出戰士卒以濕具覆身，並在護國門與絕壁一線鋪沙袋隔絕火頭。除燃燒器材外，此役蒙古軍的攻城器械組合還包括雲梯、撞車、飛石機與巢車，圍城靠壘築與壕溝，就糧靠嘉陵江運船與陸路轉輸；守軍一方是弓弩、礮石、滾木與關樓。護國門前那道一字槽是沿峭壁開鑿的狹溝，兩側壁立如削，門一開便成死地，兩軍在這裡的攻防最能說明山城作戰的樣態：一方要把木構攻城器械送上峭壁，一方只要把水、矢石與滾木堆在通道口。希臘火式的覆蓋燃燒本可在這裡發揮作用，但山城居高臨下、火攻難以附著，最終決定戰局的仍是糧道、牆體與時間。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire: a liquid incendiary kept secret by the Byzantine Empire from the seventh century onward, carried in bronze tubes or jars, forced out and ignited by hand so as to burn enemy ships and siege engines. The formula was the empire's highest secret and is said to have gone down with a ship that sank, so on the scale of arms it stands for one particular line of technology: secret formula, bronze container, blanket coverage by fire. There was no Byzantine bronze tube on the field at Diaoyu, and that has to be stated plainly. What the Mongol army actually carried were gunpowder charges and crude bombards; jars of burning oil and gunpowder charges appear in the Mongol siege accounts of these years. On the Song side the counter-measures were water stored on every tower and fighting platform to meet enemy fire, troops going out wrapped in wet gear, and sandbags laid along the Huguo Gate and the cliff line to cut off the flame. Beyond the incendiaries, the Mongol siege train in this campaign comprised scaling ladders, battering rams, traction trebuchets and siege towers, with the investment carried by ramparts and ditches, and supply coming by boat on the Jialing and by land convoy. The defenders had crossbows, stone-throwers, rolling logs and gate towers. The yizicao in front of the Huguo Gate was a narrow channel cut along the cliff, with sheer walls on both sides, so that opening the gate turned it into a killing ground; the fighting there shows the character of warfare in a mountain fortress better than anything else in the campaign, with one side trying to bring timber siege engines up a cliff and the other needing only to pile water, arrows, stones and logs at the mouth of the passage. A Greek fire of the blanket-burning kind could have earned its place here, but fire will not cling to a position that looks down from above, and in the end it was grain, masonry and time that settled the contest.
tactics: 蒙古軍的攻城序列是標準的草原式圍城：先以騎兵封鎖陸路與江面，斷絕城內對外聯繫，再在城外築壘列陣，造雲梯、撞車、飛石機逼近城牆，主攻方向選在護國門與東新門一線。護國門前的通道名叫一字槽，係沿峭壁開鑿的狹溝，門兩側壁立如削，門上建關樓，開門即成甕城；蒙哥下令開門進攻，宋軍以礮石、滾木從兩壁傾砸，蒙古攻隊折損慘重而退，隨即改為夜襲與攀城，以鉤索、油布裹身之法附壁而上，屢為守軍射落。夜襲之外，蒙古軍還以火藥炸藥與毒煙試圖擾亂守軍，卻因城高路險、火難附著而收效有限；守軍在城頭以弓弩、礮石分層射擊，輪番休息，井井有條。守方最要命的一著是把糧食、彈藥與水源一起困在城內：釣魚山有田地可供春夏出屯耕作，泉井終年不涸，城中屯糧可支較久；蒙古軍則靠嘉陵江運船、靠陸路牛馬轉輸，遠道糧運在山城下的消耗極大，於是包圍變成拉鋸。扭轉局面的並非任何攻城技術，而是蒙哥本人的死：七月的消息一到，營中人心崩解，蒙古軍解圍北還，宋守軍則守住了開戰時就已握在手中的山城。
tacticsEn: The Mongol procedure was that of a classic steppe investment. Cavalry first sealed the roads and the river and cut the city off from contact with the outside, then ramparts were raised outside and the army deployed, while scaling ladders, battering rams and traction trebuchets were built and brought up against the wall; the chosen point of attack was the line of the Huguo Gate and the Dongxin Gate. The passage in front of the Huguo Gate is called the yizicao, a narrow channel cut along the cliff with sheer walls on both sides and a gate tower overhead, so that opening the gate turned it into a killing jar. When Möngke ordered the gate opened and the assault delivered, the Song garrison hurled stones and rolling logs down both walls, and the attacking columns were cut down and driven back. The assault then turned to night attacks and climbing, men going up the rock with ropes and hooks and their bodies wrapped in oiled cloth, only to be shot off again by the defenders. Alongside the night attacks the Mongols used gunpowder charges and poisoned smoke to disorder the garrison, but with the walls high and the paths narrow, and fire unable to take hold, the effect was limited. The defenders replied with crossbows and stones worked in tiers along the ramparts, relieved in turn, and the manning was methodical. The crucial move on the Song side was to keep grain, ammunition and water inside the walls: the hill had fields to till in spring and summer, the spring never failed, and the stores in the city would last a long while. The Mongols by contrast moved provisions by boat on the Jialing and by cattle and horses overland, and the cost of hauling food that far under a mountain fortress was ruinous, so the siege degenerated into a grind of attrition. What finally broke the deadlock was not any technique of assault but the death of Möngke himself: when the news came in the seventh month, the camp fell apart, the Mongols lifted the siege and marched north, and the Song garrison kept the mountain it had held from the first day of the fight.
data: 可核的數字不多，但都可靠。釣魚山在嘉陵江與渠江合流處的半島上，面積約2.5平方公里，外城築在懸崖峭壁之上，牆以條石壘成，全城有八座城門，護國門外就是那道一字槽；山中有始關泉，泉終年不涸，城內尚有田地，合州城在釣魚城西約五公里，兩地由江道與山道相連。時間刻度上，1258年秋蒙哥大軍入蜀，十月進抵釣魚城下開始合圍，圍城歷時逾半年，1259年正月汪德臣病逝軍中，七月蒙哥死於軍中，八、九月間蒙古軍北撤；蒙哥生於1209年，卒於1259年。兵員方面，元代記載常見的數十萬、百萬之數是典型的誇飾，學界一般認為蒙古在川的兵力當在數萬量級，攻城正面之眾更少；宋方守軍以精兵數千為骨幹，加上屯軍與丁壯，可上萬。器械方面，投石機與砲的射程以數百步計，雲梯一次所載不過百餘人，折損皆集中於城門一線。死傷確數不可考：攻城半年反覆突破，蒙古前鋒折損慘重，其後以追贈官爵撫恤；宋軍的傷亡數字在現存史籍中同樣無從核實。遺址方面，釣魚城遺址於1996年11月20日公布為全國重點文物保護單位，1982年與縉雲山、北溫泉一併列入國家重點風景名勝區。
dataEn: There are not many figures that can be checked, but the ones there are hold up. Diaoyu hill stands on a peninsula where the Jialing and the Qu rivers join, covers an area of about 2.5 square kilometres, and its outer enceinte was built on the cliffs with walls laid up from dressed stone. The city had eight gates, and in front of the Huguo Gate lay the yizicao. There was a spring on the hill, the Shiguan spring, that never dried up, and fields within the walls; the prefectural city of Hezhou lay about five kilometres to the west, joined to the fortress by river path and mountain track. On the timeline: in the autumn of 1258 Möngke's army entered Shu; in the tenth month it reached Diaoyu and the investment began; it lasted more than half a year, with Wang Dechen dying of illness in camp in the first month of 1259 and Möngke dying in the camp in the seventh, and the Mongols withdrawing north in the eighth and ninth. Möngke was born in 1209 and died in 1259. On numbers of men, the hundreds of thousands and millions that Yuan accounts are fond of are plain flattery; the consensus is that the Mongols had some tens of thousands in Sichuan and far fewer in the assault columns, while the Song garrison rested on some thousands of picked troops backed by garrison levies and city households, perhaps several thousand more. As for the machines, the range of trebuchets and bombards was measured in several hundred paces, a scaling ladder carried little more than a hundred men at a time, and the losses fell on the gate line. Exact casualty figures cannot be checked: the assaults were renewed again and again over half a year, the Mongol vanguard was badly cut up, and the dead were afterwards honoured by the granting of ranks and titles; the Song losses are equally beyond verification in the surviving records. On the site itself, the ruins of Diaoyu were published as a national key cultural relic protection unit on 20 November 1996, and in 1982 the hill was entered together with Jinyun Mountain and Beiquan Hot Spring into the national key scenic area.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是蒙古的總體戰略：蒙哥志在滅宋，而滅宋的先決條件是取全蜀，因為四川既能提供兵員糧源，又是順江東下的跳板；重慶與成都兩座重鎮被蜀道與峽江切割，任何一條由陝入蜀的補給線都要經過合州一帶。第二層是戰術的必然：釣魚城踞嘉陵江而建，控江、扼路、能俯瞰江面，蒙古軍若要在江邊設立船場、轉運糧械、經營進攻成都與重慶的前哨，就必須拿下或至少封死這座城，繞道意味着放棄江上最短的運輸線。第三層是宋方的體制：余玠在四川興建的山城體系，把重慶以上的江防節點全部改造成可獨立固守的石砌堡壘，釣魚城是這套體系最靠前的一環，內城有屯田、有水源、有糧儲，守軍只需死守不必求戰，這正是蒙古最不擅長的戰役。第四層是直接導火線：蒙哥大軍抵達後，蒙古曾數次勸降，王堅不從，雙方遂以攻城手段定去留；圍城曠日持久，遠方戰場又傳來不利消息，蒙古內部的分歧與南方的援軍調度糾纏其間，最終讓蒙哥的死決定了這場戰役的收場。
causeEn: There were four layers behind the fighting. The first was the general Mongol strategy. Möngke meant to destroy the Song, and the precondition for that was to take all of Sichuan, because Sichuan could furnish men and grain and served as the springboard for a descent along the river; Chongqing and Chengdu, the two great strongholds, were cut off from one another by the roads of Shu and the gorges, and every supply line entering Shu from Shaanxi passed through the region of Hezhou. The second layer was tactical necessity. Diaoyu stood on the Jialing, commanding the river, choking the road and looking down on the water below; if the Mongols were to set up a boat yard on the river, shift grain and engines, and work their forward position against Chengdu and Chongqing, they had to take the fortress or at least seal it, and a detour meant abandoning the shortest transport line on the river. The third layer was the Song system. Yu Jie's mountain-fortress programme turned every point on the river line above Chongqing into a stone redoubt that could hold on its own; Diaoyu was the outermost link in that chain, with fields inside the walls, water, and stored grain, so that the garrison only had to hold and did not have to seek battle, which is precisely the kind of war the Mongols handled worst. The fourth layer was the immediate trigger. After the arrival of the army the Mongols several times urged surrender, and Wang Jian refused; both sides then settled the matter by siege. The investment dragged on, unwelcome news arrived from distant fronts, the divisions within the Mongol camp and the arguments over relief on the Song side were tangled in with it, and in the end the death of Möngke decided how the campaign closed.
impact: 釣魚城沒有被攻下，改變的卻是兩個政權的運勢。對蒙古而言，1259年蒙哥在釣魚城下去世，等於第三次西征無疾而終，進軍歐洲的計劃永久中止；大汗之死立刻把汗位繼承問題推到台前，1260年忽必烈在開平召開忽里勒台，與留守和林的阿里不哥相爭，元朝隨之分裂，內戰數年，元氣大傷，滅宋一舉因此延後了近二十年，直至1279年方告完成。對南宋而言，釣魚城守住了，卻也只是爭取到喘息：蒙古自此改變策略，不再迷信硬攻山城，而以襄樊為突破口，1273年襄樊陷落，1276年臨安出降，1279年崖山兵敗，釣魚城亦在宋亡前後淪陷，守將張珏於1276年重慶城破被俘，後死於大都。技術層面，這一役是早期火藥兵器第一次大規模用於山城攻守的記錄，火藥炸藥對木構攻城器械有效，對石砌山城卻無能為力，蒙古此後的攻城重心轉向封鎖水路與築壘困城，這一轉向最終體現在襄樊的水路攻堅上。釣魚城遺址今為重慶市合川區的釣魚城遺址，1996年列為全國重點文物保護單位，1982年列入國家重點風景名勝區，被視為中國保存最完整的古戰場之一；據說二戰後期曾有美軍人員在重慶上空見此城未毀，稱之為上帝拒絕死亡的城市。
impactEn: Diaoyu was not taken, yet the course of two states changed. For the Mongols, Möngke's death below Diaoyu in 1259 meant that the third western campaign ended without result and that the plan of advancing into Europe was abandoned for good. The death of a great khan immediately pushed the question of succession to the front; in 1260 Kublai summoned the kurultai at Kaiping and faced Ariq Böke, who held the north at Qaraqorum, and the Mongol state split into civil war for several years, draining its strength. The destruction of the Song was consequently put off by nearly twenty years and was completed only in 1279. For the Song, holding Diaoyu bought only a respite. The Mongols changed their method, no longer trusting frontal attacks on mountain fortresses, and turned on Xiangyang instead; Xiangyang fell in 1273, Lin'an surrendered in 1276, and the Song was destroyed at Yamen in 1279. Diaoyu itself was abandoned around the end of the Song, its defender Zhang Jue having been taken prisoner when Chongqing fell in 1276 and dying later at Dadu. In technical terms this was the first large record of early gunpowder weapons used in the attack on, and the defence of, a mountain fortress: gunpowder charges worked well against timber siege engines and were powerless against stone, and the Mongol centre of gravity in siege work shifted towards sealing river routes and building invested lines, a shift that finally showed itself in the amphibious assault on Xiangyang. The ruins of Diaoyu today form the Diaoyu Fortress heritage site in Hechuan, Chongqing; they were published as a national key cultural relic protection unit in 1996 and entered the national key scenic area in 1982, and are regarded as one of the best preserved ancient battlefields in China. It is said that in the later years of the Second World War American personnel flying over Chongqing saw the fortress still standing and called it the city where God refuses to let death in.
result: 結果是蒙古軍沒有攻下釣魚城：合州一帶的堅城群被完整保留下來，蒙哥汗死在城下，屍柩送回漠北，秘葬發喪的規模在草原上罕見；宋軍守住了山城，也守住了四川防線最前面的一環，釣魚城此後繼續抗元十八年，直到宋亡前後才被迫放棄。戰役的連帶效果遠比城本身更大：蒙哥死訊一到，東路忽必烈自鄂州撤兵北還，兩個戰區同時收兵；賈似道以蒙軍北撤為由向朝廷報捷，促成開慶元年（一二五九年）十月被罷相；元廷則藉南邊鬆動之際平定李璮之亂，收拾了中原局面。對蒙古而言，此役是一堂昂貴的攻城課：山城、水路、糧運三者之中，蒙古只解決了最後一項的規模，卻在山城這一項上寸步難行，正因如此宋人才得以把襄樊之外的老四川守到最後。對南宋而言，釣魚城是一場慘勝，它延緩了亡國，卻沒有改變亡國的結局；而蒙哥之死這件看似意外的事，最終把歐洲的戰局與東亞的戰局岔成了兩條不同的路。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Mongols did not take Diaoyu. The ring of strongholds around Hezhou was preserved entire, Möngke died below the walls, and his coffin was carried back to the northern steppe where the secret burial and the funeral rites were on a scale seldom seen in the grasslands. The Song kept the fortress and with it the forwardmost link of the Sichuan defensive line; Diaoyu went on resisting the Mongols for eighteen years and was only abandoned around the collapse of the Song. The consequences of the campaign reached far beyond the fortress itself. With the news of Möngke's death, Kublai broke off the siege of Ezhou and marched north, and both theatres were closed down at once. Jia Sidao reported the Mongol withdrawal to the court as a victory, and in the tenth month of 1259 he was dismissed from office and exiled. The Yuan court used the slack in the south to suppress the revolt of Li Tan and to settle the Central Plain. For the Mongols the campaign was an expensive lesson in siegecraft: of mountains, water routes and supply, they had solved only the scale of the last, and on the first they advanced not one step, and for exactly that reason the Song could hold the old Sichuan beyond Xiangyang until the end. For the Song, Diaoyu was a bitter victory: it delayed the end of the dynasty without changing it, and the death of Möngke, which looked like an accident, sent the war in Europe and the war in East Asia down two quite different roads.
